sections.title: A café: en/ett and requests
body: Fika is a social coffee break and also a verb.
Add tack; Swedish does not use a direct equivalent of English please in every request.
Ask Innehåller den nötter? or Har ni något veganskt? when relevant.

examples.fi: Vad får det lov att vara?
Kan jag få en smörgås och ett te?
examples.en: Can I have a sandwich and tea?
No thanks. What does it cost?

sections.title: Learn each noun with en or ett
body: Most nouns are en-words, but article choice is not fully predictable. Learn the article with the noun.
Use jag vill ha or kan jag få + noun phrase to order.
Ask Vad kostar …? or Hur mycket kostar …? Answer Det kostar … kronor.

examples.fi: Kan jag få ett glas vatten?

assignment.title: Episode 10 mission: A café: en/ett and requests
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: Hear the audio twice and answer: What special request is made?

READ: Read once for purpose and once for detail. Answer: How much are tea and a bun together?

SPEAK: Order a drink and food, then ask the price. Try once without the model, then repeat more clearly.

WRITE: Write a café order with a dietary question. Check word order and spelling.

TRANSFER: Change an en-item to an ett-item.

RETURN: Order en kaffe and ett te.
assignment.model:
Speaking: Kan jag få en kaffe och en smörgås? Vad kostar det?
Writing: Jag vill ha ett te och en bulle. Innehåller bullen nötter?

takeaways: Use: Kan jag få en kaffe och ett te?
Rule: Most nouns are en-words, but article choice is not fully predictable. Learn the article with the noun.
Return: Order en kaffe and ett te.
